prescriptive_action: Introduce mandatory review friction: require a minimum dwell time and a written justification field before an approval action is accepted for this decision category.
Add a redaction filter to the logging pipeline before persistence.
Add an input-sanitization layer that screens for known jailbreak patterns before the prompt reaches the model, and pin system instructions so user content cannot override them.
Add outcome monitoring segmented by demographic group with automated alerting when disparity exceeds the configured threshold.
Restrict outbound tool/network access from the agent's execution context and add egress logging for review.
